task:
Read each prelude's CODE — the engine will execute it — and give a verdict: `ok`, or a `concern` with the
concrete problem. A concern is anything that makes the code unsafe (file / network / exec, imports outside
the allowed ones, tables it does not name) or makes it not do what its `reason` and `produces` claim. Judge
the code on its merits even if you authored it. Nothing waits for your verdict: a concern is a finding on the
targets that read the prelude's columns — it goes back to the author, unless the author's `check` already ran
that exact code on the data without failure, when it is a note for the person reviewing the output.

preludes.reason: Child age in months requires arithmetic using age in years (FK070) and month of birth (FK075); not expressible as a single-column recode.
VAR-phone requires combining landline (hh150) and mobile phone (hh160) ownership; no single source column represents any-telephone ownership.
VAR-rooms is numeric but source hh060 is stored as categorical codes; convert to numeric while preserving '10 or more' as 10.
Clean invalid age (-1) and derive under-5 age measures using year/month of birth; passthrough/value_map cannot do arithmetic.

Survey provides separate annual net income components (employee cash/near-cash and self-employment cash/in-kind) but no single labor-income total; construct a total as row-wise sum while keeping all-missing as NaN.

Household size is not present as a single household-level column; it must be counted from the full person register (silc24_pr, all ages) and then used to normalize total household disposable income (HG110) to a per-capita welfare aggregate.
